'''The Cometwash''' was the local name of a [[Blue giant/Legends|blue giant]]&ndash;type [[Star/Legends|star]] located in [[The Cometwash system/Legends|the Cometwash system]]. It was situated in the [[Back Reach]] area of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Feena Run]] connected it to the [[Korphir system/Legends|Korphir]] and [[Usta system/Legends|Usta systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Cometwash was situated at the edge of [[The Roil/Legends|the Roil]] [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] and was [[Orbit/Legends|surrounded]] by swarms of brilliant [[Comet/Legends|comets]]. [[Spacer/Legends|Spacers]] commonly reverted to [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] at the Cometwash [[Star system/Legends|system]] to recheck their [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump calculations, and the sights offered to them by the system made the location famous. Consequently, the star system of the Cometwash was also frequently visited by [[Passenger liner/Legends|starliners]] carrying skygazing tourists.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Cometwash was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-6.<ref name="TEA" />
